review: F007 AI Assistant Panel — Bug Review

issues.title: Server binds to 0.0.0.0 — API key exposed on network
issues.fix_applied: Changed host from 0.0.0.0 to 127.0.0.1

issues.title: Path traversal via project_dir — no validation
issues.notes: Accepted risk for local desktop app. project_dir flexibility is a core feature. Mitigated by B001 fix (localhost-only).

issues.title: Bash tool with acceptEdits — no approval for shell commands
issues.notes: Accepted risk. Bash access is a desired feature. Future: add tool_approval SSE event so frontend can show approve/deny dialog.

issues.title: API key potentially logged on exception
issues.fix_applied: Sanitize API key from error messages before logging: error_str.replace(api_key, 'sk-ant-***')

issues.title: setApiKey hardcodes model to claude-sonnet-4-20250514
issues.fix_applied: Removed model and whisperModel fields from save-model-config body. Only persists apiKey.

issues.title: Setup modal condition broken — project dir selection unreachable
issues.fix_applied: Changed condition to (!sessionId && meetingId && meetingTitle) || !hasApiKey. Modal now shows for both first session setup and missing API key.

issues.title: No locking on _sessions dict — concurrent requests can orphan threads
issues.fix_applied: Added _sessions_lock = asyncio.Lock(). Session creation wrapped in async with _sessions_lock.

issues.title: No cleanup when SSE client disconnects mid-stream
issues.fix_applied: Wrapped _sse_generator in try/except for asyncio.CancelledError — calls cancel_session() on client disconnect.

issues.title: No SSE heartbeat during long tool executions
issues.notes: Lower priority. Desktop app connects via localhost, unlikely to hit proxy timeouts.

issues.title: Sessions never expire — memory grows without bound
issues.fix_applied: Added _SESSION_TTL_SECS = 24h, last_active field on SessionState, _cleanup_expired_sessions() called on each request.

issues.title: thread.join(timeout=5) with no follow-up — zombie threads
issues.fix_applied: Added check: if thread.is_alive() after join, log warning.

issues.title: cancel_event.clear() creates race window
issues.notes: Edge case. Would require generation counter which adds complexity. Acceptable for current usage.

issues.title: clear_session during active streaming orphans the generator
issues.notes: Rare edge case. Would need significant refactor to separate cancel from clear. B008 mitigates via client disconnect cleanup.

issues.title: CORS allows all origins
issues.fix_applied: Restricted origins to ['http://localhost:3118', 'http://127.0.0.1:3118', 'tauri://localhost', 'https://tauri.localhost'].

issues.title: isStreaming guard uses stale closure — double-sends possible
issues.fix_applied: Added isStreamingRef = useRef(false) for synchronous double-send guard. Set/cleared in all relevant handlers.

issues.title: sendMessage recreated on every state change — cascade re-renders
issues.fix_applied: Added stateRef = useRef(state). sendMessage reads from ref, dependency array reduced to [handleStreamEvent].

issues.title: No RAF/AbortController cleanup on unmount
issues.fix_applied: Added useEffect cleanup: cancelAnimationFrame(rafIdRef) + abortRef.abort() on unmount.

issues.title: Pending message useEffect fires on sendMessage identity changes
issues.fix_applied: Added sendMessageRef pattern. useEffect dependency array reduced to [pendingFirstMessage, projectDir].

issues.title: Auto-scroll may not reflect latest content
issues.fix_applied: Wrapped scroll in requestAnimationFrame to ensure scrollHeight reflects new content after paint.

issues.title: Start Session button enabled with any non-empty text as API key
issues.fix_applied: Changed canConfirm to use isKeyValid (requires sk-ant- prefix and min length).

issues.title: Modal confirms even with empty API key
issues.fix_applied: handleConfirm now returns early if !isKeyValid.

issues.title: Context basket promises drag-and-drop that does not exist
issues.fix_applied: Changed text to 'Use the Add to AI buttons to add context'.

issues.title: Errors silently caught — no user-visible feedback
issues.fix_applied: Added toast error notification on sendMessage failure.

issues.title: Streaming cursor appears on new line instead of inline
issues.fix_applied: Appended cursor character to msg.text before passing to ReactMarkdown.

issues.title: Panel pops in/out with no slide animation
issues.fix_applied: Removed early return null. Component stays mounted with CSS: translate-x-0/translate-x-full + pointer-events-none.

issues.title: Modal does not close on Escape key
issues.fix_applied: Added useEffect with document keydown listener for Escape key.

issues.title: Modal backdrop does not close on click
issues.fix_applied: Added onClick={onCancel} on backdrop div + stopPropagation on modal content.

issues.title: Remove button invisible on touch devices
issues.notes: Desktop app only. Touch devices not a primary target. Low impact.

issues.title: API key prefix check is redundant and too permissive
issues.fix_applied: Simplified to startsWith('sk-ant-') with minimum length check (>20 chars).

issues.title: Date.now() message IDs could collide
issues.fix_applied: Changed to crypto.randomUUID() for unique message IDs.

issues.title: SSE parser does not flush final buffer
issues.fix_applied: Added buffer flush after read loop exits to process remaining SSE data.

issues.title: BACKEND URL duplicated across files
issues.fix_applied: Exported BACKEND from claudeService.ts, imported in ClaudeContext.tsx.

issues.title: API key fetch useEffect has no cleanup
issues.fix_applied: Added AbortController with cleanup in useEffect return.

issues.title: model parameter not validated on backend
issues.fix_applied: Added _VALID_MODELS set and validation at start of stream_session.
